The structure of Ho2Mn2Sb2O16 (HoMnSbO8) is tetragonal, space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 22 atoms in the unit cell across five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Ho and Mn each octahedrally coordinated by six O neighbors, while Sb is tetrahedrally coordinated by four O neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Ho octahedra and Sb tetrahedra, and between Mn octahedra and Sb tetrahedra; the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 22 sites.
